reward.title: Колокол героя
reward.reason: Действующий «Герой деревни» подтверждает серьёзный успех; можно взять один полезный предмет снаряжения.
reward.notes: Ни один вариант не является оружием босса или готовым Nightfall. Выбор один; выдавать штатные предметы без произвольных чар или усиленного NBT. Условие доказывает только текущий эффект, а не завершение рейда; при дешёвом альтернативном источнике этого эффекта снизить бюджет награды, не менять детектор.

description: Structural bosses use their registered arena, safe entry and exit, dormant pre-start state, participant authority and historical defeat. The Twelve Eyes journey reads those records; it does not keep a second kill list.
quests.title: Hosted Encounters

description: Prepare food, armor and a shield before accepting an encounter. Approaching a dormant structural boss does not start combat.
quests.title: Prepare, Then Start

description: Historic inventory-goal completion is retained without treating ordinary Eyes as proof of the Twelve Eyes campaign.
quests.title: Archived inventory goal

description: Parties are optional. Solo and grouped starts use the same authoritative participant, elimination, boundary and reward lifecycle.
quests.title: Solo or Together

description: Create remains the owner of machines, recipes, stress and trains. JEM observes legitimate engineering activity without replacing native balance.
quests.title: First Cogwheel

description: Use Create's native wrench to configure and move supported machinery. Train speed remains entirely native.
quests.title: Native Tools

description: A Mechanical Press is a practical first processing line. Building Areas can coordinate a factory footprint without claiming land.
quests.title: First Processing Line

description: Halloween runs October 29 through November 1. New Year runs December 24 through January 7 in the configured server timezone. Use /jem holiday to read the authoritative lifecycle.
quests.title: Seasonal Calendar

description: Pumpkins are an ordinary peaceful Halloween decorating and foraging material. Participation is optional and never a login reward.
quests.title: Halloween — Lanterns

description: New Year supports voluntary gifts and community gathering. Real items always stay in an owner-safe inventory flow; no Coin is minted for logging in.
quests.title: New Year — Celebration

description: Hosted combat and recurring waves are opt-in. Existing event priorities, boundaries, elimination rules and block-damage protections remain authoritative.
quests.title: Optional Event Combat

description: Xaero terrain and authoritatively discovered boss locations may be shared. Your waypoints, homes, labels, groups, settings and death points remain yours.
quests.title: Carry a Map

description: A spyglass is useful for real landmark visits. Shared discoveries record an actual server-side location rather than trusting a client label.
quests.title: Observe the Horizon

description: On Xaero World Map choose Building Areas, drag the intended rectangle, name it, and confirm. It is a planning overlay—not a claim or block permission.
quests.title: Plan a Building Area

description: Gather ordinary logs. Native item detection completes this step; no duplicate starter kit or Coin reward is created.
quests.title: First Materials

description: Make the basic work surface used throughout every playstyle. Nothing in JEM locks normal Minecraft progression.
quests.title: A Place to Work

description: A compass supports exploration, shared boss discoveries and map planning. Personal waypoints and bases remain private.
quests.title: Choose Your Direction

description: Wallet and physical cash are two forms of one fixed Coin supply. Open /coins to see balance, backed cash, every denomination and Deposit/Withdraw actions.
quests.title: A Physical Coin

description: Spud shops keep real blocks and stock. JEM catalog purchases use the numeric Coin price, reserve funds, recheck stock, deliver the item, then credit the seller.
quests.title: Trade Without a Faucet

description: Craft a Shipping Box from a chest surrounded by planks. It binds to your authenticated account, accepts only goods with both buy and sell prices, and pays backed physical Coins at 06:00.
quests.title: Shipping Box

description: Put an approved canonical stack into the input rows. Preview uses today's two demand groups; the dawn transaction re-quotes, consumes only accepted units and puts provenance-backed Coins in the payout row.
quests.title: Ship Your First Box

description: Earn and collect at least one Silver Coin. Ten boxes still share one 80-Copper account cap; villager sales and public NPC orders use that same cap.
quests.title: Earn Your First Silver

description: Each market day selects two shared groups at 150% and 125%. Confirm one sale while a listed good is in demand; boosts never bypass account, world, item or funded-market limits.
quests.title: Market-Demand Day

description: Open a villager. Supported emerald offers appear in the Coin adapter only when the traded item has both prices. Unsupported or progression offers show no transaction and never yield an emerald backdoor.
quests.title: Trade with a Villager

description: Find a real bell and use it to open Town founding. Names must be unique; towns stay separated; creating one never creates a land claim.
quests.title: Town Hall Bell

description: Only registered residents have JEM mood. Drop one genuine edible item within 3 blocks of a hungry resident; one unit is accepted, repeated food is damped and unsafe food always hurts. Use /jem town feedstorage on while looking at a linked container for explicit storage feeding.
Счастье JEM есть только у зарегистрированных жителей. Голодный житель принимает ровно один съедобный предмет; повторы слабее, опасная еда всегда портит настроение.
quests.title: How to Feed / Как кормить

description: Around a linked home or workplace combine at least three categories: comfort, lit warmth, greenery, culture, work identity and social furniture. Distinct blocks matter; 100 identical lanterns still give only the first small contribution.
У кровати и рабочего места сочетайте хотя бы три категории уюта. Разные предметы важнее спама одинаковыми фонарями.
quests.title: Happiness Guide / Счастье

description: Tier upgrades use verified homes, native work variety, linked real storage and happiness. Physical building projects remain disabled until an authored, permission-safe blueprint exists; the town never paints a placeholder house over player blocks.
Уровень города зависит от настоящих домов, работ, склада и счастья. Без проверенного чертежа город не строит временные дома поверх ваших блоков.

Structural bosses use their registered arena, safe entry and exit, dormant pre-start state, participant authority and historical defeat. The Twelve Eyes journey reads those records; it does not keep a second kill list.
1100000000000005.title: Hosted Encounters

description: Prepare food, armor and a shield before accepting an encounter. Approaching a dormant structural boss does not start combat.
1100000000000015.title: Prepare, Then Start

description: Historic inventory-goal completion is retained without treating ordinary Eyes as proof of the Twelve Eyes campaign.
1100000000000025.title: Archived inventory goal

description: Parties are optional. Solo and grouped starts use the same authoritative participant, elimination, boundary and reward lifecycle.
1100000000000035.title: Solo or Together

description: Create remains the owner of machines, recipes, stress and trains. JEM observes legitimate engineering activity without replacing native balance.
1100000000000006.title: First Cogwheel

description: Use Create's native wrench to configure and move supported machinery. Train speed remains entirely native.
1100000000000016.title: Native Tools

description: A Mechanical Press is a practical first processing line. Building Areas can coordinate a factory footprint without claiming land.
1100000000000036.title: First Processing Line

description: Halloween runs October 29 through November 1. New Year runs December 24 through January 7 in the configured server timezone. Use /jem holiday to read the authoritative lifecycle.
1100000000000008.title: Seasonal Calendar

description: Pumpkins are an ordinary peaceful Halloween decorating and foraging material. Participation is optional and never a login reward.
1100000000000018.title: Halloween — Lanterns

description: New Year supports voluntary gifts and community gathering. Real items always stay in an owner-safe inventory flow; no Coin is minted for logging in.
1100000000000028.title: New Year — Celebration

description: Hosted combat and recurring waves are opt-in. Existing event priorities, boundaries, elimination rules and block-damage protections remain authoritative.
1100000000000038.title: Optional Event Combat

description: Xaero terrain and authoritatively discovered boss locations may be shared. Your waypoints, homes, labels, groups, settings and death points remain yours.
1100000000000004.title: Carry a Map

description: A spyglass is useful for real landmark visits. Shared discoveries record an actual server-side location rather than trusting a client label.
1100000000000014.title: Observe the Horizon

description: On Xaero World Map choose Building Areas, drag the intended rectangle, name it, and confirm. It is a planning overlay—not a claim or block permission.
1100000000000024.title: Plan a Building Area

description: Gather ordinary logs. Native item detection completes this step; no duplicate starter kit or Coin reward is created.
1100000000000011.title: First Materials

description: Make the basic work surface used throughout every playstyle. Nothing in JEM locks normal Minecraft progression.
1100000000000021.title: A Place to Work

description: A compass supports exploration, shared boss discoveries and map planning. Personal waypoints and bases remain private.
1100000000000031.title: Choose Your Direction

description: Wallet and physical cash are two forms of one fixed Coin supply. Open /coins to see balance, backed cash, every denomination and Deposit/Withdraw actions.
1100000000000007.title: A Physical Coin

description: Spud shops keep real blocks and stock. JEM catalog purchases use the numeric Coin price, reserve funds, recheck stock, deliver the item, then credit the seller.
1100000000000017.title: Trade Without a Faucet

description: Craft a Shipping Box from a chest surrounded by planks. It binds to your authenticated account, accepts only goods with both buy and sell prices, and pays backed physical Coins at 06:00.
1100000000000047.title: Shipping Box

description: Put an approved canonical stack into the input rows. Preview uses today's two demand groups; the dawn transaction re-quotes, consumes only accepted units and puts provenance-backed Coins in the payout row.
1100000000000057.title: Ship Your First Box

description: Earn and collect at least one Silver Coin. Ten boxes still share one 80-Copper account cap; villager sales and public NPC orders use that same cap.
1100000000000067.title: Earn Your First Silver

description: Each market day selects two shared groups at 150% and 125%. Confirm one sale while a listed good is in demand; boosts never bypass account, world, item or funded-market limits.
